items.name: Regular Hashbrowns (Plain)
items.description: Shredded real potatoes scattered on a flat-top grill coated with oil and seared until golden crisp.

items.name: Large Hashbrowns
items.description: Double portion of shredded potatoes scattered and grilled to golden crispness.

items.name: Triple Hashbrowns
items.description: Triple portion of shredded real potatoes griddled until evenly golden and crisp.

items.name: Hashbrowns Scattered, Smothered & Covered
items.description: Shredded hashbrowns scattered on the grill, topped with sautéed onions (Smothered) and melted American cheese slices (Covered).

items.name: Hashbrowns All-The-Way
items.description: Hashbrowns loaded with every menu topping: onions, cheese, ham, tomatoes, jalapeños, mushrooms, chili, and gravy.

items.name: Topping - Smothered (Sautéed Onions)
items.description: Fresh diced yellow onions sautéed on the flat top grill until sweet and translucent.

items.name: Topping - Covered (Melted American Cheese)
items.description: Slices of classic yellow American cheese melted over hot hashbrowns.

items.name: Topping - Chunked (Hickory Smoked Ham)
items.description: Diced hickory-smoked city ham seared on the grill and mixed into hashbrowns.

items.name: Topping - Diced (Grilled Tomatoes)
items.description: Fresh diced red tomatoes lightly grilled on the flat top.

items.name: Topping - Peppered (Jalapeño Peppers)
items.description: Sliced pickled jalapeño peppers tossed onto hot hashbrowns for heat.

items.name: Topping - Capped (Grilled Mushrooms)
items.description: Sliced button mushrooms sautéed on the grill until tender.

items.name: Topping - Topped (Bert's Chili™)
items.description: Signature beef and bean chili ladled warm over crispy hashbrowns.

items.name: Topping - Country (Sausage Gravy)
items.description: Rich, white peppered sausage gravy smothered over hot hashbrowns.
